mandatory_gates_in_order: capture identity, registration, exact encoded/source timing, zero timestamp/missing/extra/duration errors, and immutable input-only selection manifest are verified
deduplicate by video_frame_index; conflicting observations for one source image abort all classification
candidate is a maximal nonempty main_arrows ambiguous run [a,b] inside one predeclared input-only sequence event; unreadable is never an arrow phase edge
the fixed chain [a-3,b+3] is present entirely inside that event; support pairs are [a-3,a-2] and [b+2,b+3], with no search or substitution
every neighboring video_frame_index and source_frame_seq increments by exactly one, capture_ns strictly increases, and each gap is at most the verified capture maximum source interval
actual endpoint span capture_ns(b+2)-capture_ns(a-2) is at most 96000000 + verified capture maximum source interval nanoseconds
all four fixed support images are definite and readable; each same-side pair has one agreeing arrow-set value, without requiring equal brightness
endpoint arrow sets differ by exactly one direction
nearest images a-1 and b+1 are definite and readable with values in the endpoint phase sets; an extra direction may not change state
the resolved main-arrow expectation is identical throughout the full fixed chain and is exactly the two endpoint phase sets
every run frame is ambiguous solely because the changed direction is partial or faint; every extra direction stays in its endpoint definite state
all profiles contain 16 finite values in [0,255] with the same 4x4 schema and direction reference bounds
changed-direction separation S between the two fixed outer support profiles at a-3 and b+3 is at least 52.0; there is no fallback or anchor search
every interior changed-direction profile from a-2 through b+2, including the nearest readable frames a-1 and b+1, has -0.05 <= alpha <= 1.05 and rho <= 0.15
the alpha sequence including outer supports has no backward step above 0.05 and total backward motion at most 0.10
each extra direction has profile diameter RMS at most 8.0 across the full fixed chain [a-3,b+3]
raw observations remain unchanged; the qualified record affects main_arrows only and is honored only when classifier_id is explicitly policy-listed

change_scope: Extend support placement by one fixed source frame on each side: target [a,b] retains support pairs [a-3,a-2] and [b+2,b+3], and every frame of [a-3,b+3] is checked. The actual endpoints are a-2 and b+2 for the unchanged authored-span bound. Record keys are unchanged; profile_frame_indices and corresponding metric arrays contain the full interior [a-2,b+2]. No anchor search, brightness-equality requirement, numerical threshold change, or raw observation rewrite. Fresh schema-2 blind qualification is required; prior failed campaign labels remain locked.

fixed_support.target_run: maximal raw ambiguous run with first index a and last index b; unchanged by support selection
fixed_support.checked_chain: every source-consecutive frame from a-3 through b+3, inclusive
fixed_support.profile_frame_indices: every source-consecutive frame from a-2 through b+2, inclusive
fixed_support.presence_agreement: each fixed outer pair must have definite, readable, agreeing arrow sets; equal brightness is not required
fixed_support.nearest_readable_images: a-1 and b+1 must remain definite and readable, with values in the endpoint phase sets, and participate in every interpolation and motion check
fixed_support.missing_or_out_of_event_support: reject; do not search, shorten the bracket, or substitute another frame
